name: milai-source-selection-v2-fixed4
job_order: Seeds0,1,2;reference/source for even seeds,source/reference for odd seeds;serial root process,no retry.
update_rule: Two full passes of the larger eligible count rounded up to full16-example update windows. Frozen from data only before forwards.
checkpoint_rule: Use fixed final188-update checkpoint for everyseed/recipe;half checkpoint diagnostic only.
option_schedule: Shared state_id,seed,data-pass integer seed;no content hash. Same shared-state option order despite different label masks.
source_family_scope: 128admitted train families retained in reports; actual gradient family counts differ because empty-label states are not fitted. Not a9familymicrofit.
comparison_scope: Complete supervision recipe including labels/masks,at matched updates and common initialization. Different eligible examples and tokens are measured;not equalFLOPs,pure-label-only causal isolation,data-scale effect or head-architecture effect.
saved_weight_rule: Checkpoint writer storesFP16;all final probes/selection reload that exact saved artifact asFP32. TrainingFP32dev predictions are separate learning diagnostics,not reused as reloaded predictions.

evaluation.methods: All6new final checkpoints,BASEzero-shot,all3prior128nativefinal checkpoints,BM25fixed4,densefixed4,andfullpool.13arms/cohort;no bestseed selection. Prior models use their original task with STOP ignored for fixed4;new/BASE use open-only task.
evaluation.reader: Use existing source-only Reader endpoint,prompt,decoding and first-failure policy. Reuse only exactly identical rendered input;all actual and gross costs disclosed.
evaluation.reserved_review: After method freeze only;source-first judgments before native-answer/model-output comparison. No gradients/tuning from these families.
evaluation.native_scores: Original answers retained with dataset/reference scoring explicitly identified;source semantic criteria separate,including qualified answers.
evaluation.response_review: All first responses source/citation/contract reviewed before method mapping;assistant/partial blinding only,no independentgold claim.

robustness.scope: Acceptance in both views primary,canonical exact-choice invariance secondary;mask/qualified denominators explicit.
robustness.contrast_scope: Identical questions,candidates and actions;neutral-ID literal observed-premise copies change. Controlled complement-selection diagnosis,not natural counterfactual coverage. Natural positive/insufficient variants also compared in actualQA.

adoption: Research only. Keep strongdensebaseline and prior native positive signal;no automaticSTOP/default adoption orWriterclaim. Negative/qualified scientific outcome is valid after every frozen stage and analysis is executed,not a reason to reroll.
